headerDisplay: Control your Frigidaire WiFi (Connected) air conditioners from HomeKit. Sign in with the same account you use in the Frigidaire app.
footerDisplay: Each AC is exposed as a HeaterCooler (cooling), a fan with speed and vertical swing, an Eco-mode switch, and a filter-status sensor.

countryCode.title: Country Code
countryCode.description: ISO country code for your Frigidaire account region (e.g. US, CA).

pollingInterval.title: Polling Interval (ms)
pollingInterval.description: How often to refresh state from the Frigidaire cloud. Too low may trigger rate limiting.

cacheRefreshToken.title: Cache Refresh Token
cacheRefreshToken.description: Cache the auth token next to your Homebridge config to minimize logins.
